name: Jordan
label: Auto-update off, rolls back versions
who: I've used Spotify since around 2008 and I have a paid plan, but I keep auto-updates off or run an older app version so the layout does not change under me. I mainly want to listen to music and keep things where I left them.
value_for_money: Implies the paid plan depends on the app staying as it was: they describe cancelling and uninstalling after an unwanted update. The evidence does not discuss price.
loyalty: Stays by avoiding the new layout through older versions and disabled updates; would cancel if a forced update makes the new layout permanent.
pain_points: Updates change the UI without warning
UI can change overnight without an update
likes: The classic interface before the redesign
tone: Practical and matter-of-fact, giving workaround tips with some sarcasm.
